Better batch throughput, separate progress estimates, and ready-to-share result archives.

## Highlights

- Runs two Compact jobs concurrently on the reference M5 when live resource checks permit it; Macs with more performance cores may run three.
- Shows separate Active and Queue progress bars with rolling completion estimates.
- Weights queue progress by recording duration and keeps the displayed percentage monotonic.
- Rechecks available worker slots every two seconds so pending files can start when temporary resource pressure clears.
- Creates a same-named ZIP archive beside every transcript result folder.
- Keeps beam search and context settings unchanged across scheduling decisions.

## Install

Download **Transcriber-1.2.2-macOS-arm64.zip**, unzip it, and move `Transcriber.app` to Applications.

**Requirements:** Apple Silicon and macOS 13.3 or newer.

If macOS blocks the first launch, Control-click `Transcriber.app`, choose **Open**, then confirm **Open**.

[Compare changes from v1.2.1](https://github.com/Pluze/transcriber/compare/v1.2.1...v1.2.2)
